verdict.rationale: Baseten documents multiple concrete speed-oriented features: TensorRT-LLM optimized container builds (baseten-gh-2/6), token streaming for fast time-to-first-token (baseten-docs-8/26), automatic KV-cache prefix caching and session-affinity routing to boost cache hits and reduce latency (baseten-docs-41/42), and a dedicated Performance Client for high-concurrency/high-throughput requests across languages (baseten-docs-49), plus support for high-performance inference engines like vLLM/SGLang/TensorRT-LLM (baseten-gh-4/5). This directly targets both low-latency and high-throughput generation needs for latency-sensitive workloads. Missing for 10: independent benchmark data or hands-on latency/throughput comparisons (community evidence only tangentially touches client-side bottlenecks, not server-side TTFT/throughput validation).
